# CouponDonation

> CouponDonation turns donations into store coupons and gift cards for people in need in the United States. 100% of each gift goes to the family; nothing is paid out as cash, and every dollar is tracked.

CouponDonation Inc. is a US company (a Delaware corporation), not a registered 501(c)(3) charity, so gifts are not tax-deductible. People in need post a fundraiser and say which stores would help most. Donors give to a fundraiser and choose the stores their gift is used at, such as Walmart, Target, Kroger, CVS or DoorDash. The team then issues store coupons and gift cards for the recipient. CouponDonation takes no platform fee; it runs on optional tips donors can add at checkout. Store names are trademarks of their owners, and the stores are not affiliated with CouponDonation.
